skill.description: 当用户需要做抖音趋势洞察、抖音趋势分析、热点观察、内容方向判断、趋势线索归纳或营销灵感整理时使用。面向内容运营、品牌调研和创作者。
skill.summary: Explore Douyin hot searches and filtered content samples through SocialDataX to support evidence-based content planning.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: All 63 static alerts are false positives involving Markdown formatting, documented service links, legitimate credential references, or readable Chinese text. A separate dependency risk exists because the examples execute an unpinned npm package with access to the configured API key. No evidence found of embedded secrets, credential exfiltration instructions, or prompt injection.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples automatically execute socialdatax-skills@latest with access to the configured service credential.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify package integrity and dependencies, and use an isolated environment containing only the required service credential.

semantic_findings.description: Both examples run npx -y socialdatax-skills@latest, allowing automatic execution of changing npm code. The process inherits the configured API credential, so a compromised release could access secrets or modify local files despite the read-only workflow.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The commands explicitly select @latest and suppress the npx installation prompt with -y. Credential use is documented, but the external package implementation is unavailable.

content.user_title: Explore Douyin Trends and Content Signals
content.value_statement: Content teams need current Douyin signals and traceable examples before choosing topics. This skill guides SocialDataX queries and separates observed evidence from content recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Guide retrieval of current Douyin hot-search rankings and heat signals through SocialDataX CLI or configured MCP tools.
Search Douyin content by keyword with sorting, publication-time, duration, and content-type filters.
Control search collection through page limits, item limits, and opaque continuation tokens.
Organize returned titles, authors, links, content identifiers, and available metrics for traceable research.
Separate hot-search evidence, keyword-search samples, and analytical judgments in readable summaries.
Preserve partial results and guide continuation within the original collection limits after failures.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key, network access, and sufficient service balance.
CLI use requires Node.js and npm; the documented commands execute an external package whose implementation is not included.
Search has no stable complete-result boundary, so samples cannot establish comprehensive platform coverage or guaranteed trends.
The documented workflow does not log in, publish, like, comment, or modify accounts.

use_cases.title: Select Creator Topics
use_cases.description: Review current hot searches and relevant content samples before selecting the next video topic.

use_cases.title: Research Brand Conversations
use_cases.description: Search a brand keyword with consistent filters and preserve source links for a research brief.

use_cases.title: Plan an Editorial Queue
use_cases.description: Compare recent content samples with highly liked examples and distinguish evidence from proposed content angles.

prompt_templates.title: Review the Hot-Search List
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve the current Douyin hot-search list. Summarize returned rankings and heat signals, and separate your observations from suggested topic angles.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Douyin for [keyword] using one page. Summarize relevant samples and retain returned titles, authors, links or identifiers, and content types.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: collect a focused topic sample.

prompt_templates.title: Filter Recent Videos
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [keyword] for videos published within one week and under one minute. Sort newest first and stop after 20 items or two pages.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: research a specific content format.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Content Angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [keyword] twice: newest first and most liked first. Use identical weekly filters, with two pages or 20 items per search. Compare themes, cite returned evidence, and label hypotheses. Keep hot-search findings separate. Preserve partial results and respect original limits when resuming.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare bounded samples with traceable conclusions.

output_examples.input: Show the report format for a Douyin hot-search review.
output: Illustrative format only; no live results were retrieved.
Hot-search evidence: returned rank, topic, and heat signal.
Interpretation: why the topic may fit the requested audience.
Next question: which related keyword should receive a focused sample search?

output_examples.input: Show the report format when a keyword search returns partial results.
output: Illustrative format only; no live results were retrieved.
Search scope: keyword, filters, sorting, and requested collection limits.
Available evidence: returned titles, authors, content types, links or identifiers, and available metrics.
Collection status: results are incomplete; preserve the returned samples and error.
Continuation: resume only with a nonempty returned token and the remaining page and item allowances.

best_practices: Start with one page and explicit collection limits; expand only when more evidence is needed.
Keep hot-search signals separate from keyword samples, and retain source identifiers for important conclusions.
Use a reviewed, pinned CLI package in an isolated environment, and keep the API key out of prompts and reports.
anti_patterns: Treating hot-search rankings or small keyword samples as proof of future performance or complete platform coverage.
Editing pagination tokens, changing filters during continuation, or restarting partial searches without accounting for collected results.
Repeatedly retrying insufficient-balance errors or exposing service credentials during troubleshooting.

faq.question: What must be configured before use?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and service balance. CLI use also requires Node.js, npm, and network access; configured MCP tools provide another documented route.

faq.question: Can I view hot searches without a keyword?
faq.answer: Yes. The hot-search command and corresponding MCP tool do not require a keyword.

faq.question: Which search filters are documented?
faq.answer: Search supports sorting, publication-time ranges, duration ranges, and video or image content types.

faq.question: Can it retrieve every matching Douyin result?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable complete-result boundary. Use page and item limits, and describe the returned collection as a sample.

faq.question: Does the workflow post content or access browser sessions?
faq.answer: The instructions exclude browser data access and account actions. External npm package behavior was not inspected, so read-only guarantees require dependency review.

faq.question: What happens when balance is insufficient or results are partial?
faq.answer: Stop balance retries and use the documented billing page. Preserve partial results, then resume with the returned token and remaining limits after resolution.
